newsitem.title: USA: Weingarten files $226.5 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Weingarten files $226.5 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Weingarten Realty Investors filed Tuesday a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $226.5 million in debt securities, preferred and common stock and warrants to buy those securities.
When combined with previous registrations, the company said it will have up to $250 million of securities available for sale.
Majority of the net proceeds will be used to repay debt, make improvement to properties, acquire and develop additional properties and for working capital, it said.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
